name: KYC Document Summarizer
businessPurpose: Cut the time analysts spend reading onboarding documents by summarizing them for the KYC case file.

killSwitch.description: Compliance IT can switch the summarizer off per business line from the case system.

description: When a new onboarding case opens, the agent reads the documents the customer uploaded, such as passports, proof of address and company registration papers, and writes a draft summary note with any gaps it sees. A KYC analyst must review and accept the note before it is saved to the case. The agent never approves or rejects a customer.
